API Reference#

This page documents the public Python API of ANTARES. Source code links are provided via the [source] buttons on each entry.

Pipeline — public API#

These are the functions and classes exported by the pipeline package and used directly by the operator GUI.

pipeline.get_user_info

Validate intake inputs, create the visit log file, and update subject_info.json.

pipeline.compute_pta

Load audiometry .mat files and return the PTA4 mean across both ears.

pipeline.run_baseline

Record a resting-state baseline using ANT's NFRealtime.

pipeline.run_full_analysis

Run the complete offline analysis pipeline in a single call.

pipeline.compute_quick_feature_metrics

Compute SNR, ICC, and dynamic range for a single sensor-power feature.

pipeline.run_nf_session

Run the personalised closed-loop neurofeedback session with rest/NF blocks.

pipeline.SessionManager

Manages adaptive NF target selection across multiple visits.

Analysis#

Offline preprocessing, feature extraction, normative scoring, and ranking.

pipeline.analysis.preprocess_baseline

Load, filter, re-reference, epoch, and AutoReject the baseline recording.

pipeline.analysis.extract_features

Extract band-power and coherence features in sensor and source space.

pipeline.analysis.compute_reliability_metrics

Compute ICC, SNR, dynamic range, and stationarity for each feature.

pipeline.analysis.compute_dev_scores

Score each feature against normative models using pcntoolkit.

pipeline.analysis.rank_features

Rank all features by composite score and select the NF target.

pipeline.analysis.generate_selection_report_html

Generate a PNG summary figure and a self-contained HTML report for feature selection.

pipeline.analysis.track_feature_across_sessions

Compare the stability of the primary selected feature across visits.

pipeline.analysis.run_full_analysis

Run the complete offline analysis pipeline in a single call.

pipeline.analysis.compute_quick_feature_metrics

Compute SNR, ICC, and dynamic range for a single sensor-power feature.

Session#

NF session runner, block scheduler, and OSC bridge.

pipeline.session.BlockScheduler

Drives a rest / NF block sequence in a background daemon thread.

pipeline.session.RspvOSCSender

Bridges ANT's OSC output to rspv's /rspv address format.

pipeline.session.BlockAwareOSCSender

Wraps an OSCSender and silences it during rest blocks.

pipeline.session.create_protocol

Instantiate an ANT feedback protocol object from a name string.

pipeline.session.parse_feature_name

Extract ANT modality parameters from a ranked-feature name string.

pipeline.session.create_nf_yaml

Generate a personalised ANT config YAML from the selection report JSON.

pipeline.session.save_session_metadata

Save session parameters and an ISO timestamp to a JSON metadata file.

pipeline.session.run_nf_session

Run the personalised closed-loop neurofeedback session with rest/NF blocks.

Adaptive selection#

Multi-session adaptive NF target selection.

pipeline.session_manager.SessionManager

Manages adaptive NF target selection across multiple visits.

Triggers#

Hardware trigger output via serial (TriggerBox) or parallel port (LPT).

pipeline.triggers.SerialTrigger

Sends 1-byte TTL triggers via a serial COM port (e.g. BrainProducts TriggerBox on COM4).

pipeline.triggers.ParallelTrigger

Sends 1-byte TTL triggers to a parallel (LPT) port via inpoutx64.dll.

pipeline.triggers.make_trigger

Construct and return a trigger object, or None if triggers are disabled.

Intake#

pipeline.intake.get_user_info

Validate intake inputs, create the visit log file, and update subject_info.json.

pipeline.intake.compute_pta

Load audiometry .mat files and return the PTA4 mean across both ears.

Baseline recording#

pipeline.baseline.run_baseline

Record a resting-state baseline using ANT's NFRealtime.

Operator GUI#

antares_app.AntaresApp

Main ANTARES operator control panel window.
